headline: Revealed: how big a pay rise Hungarian companies are preparing, but there is one thing most of them dread
summary: Hungarian companies are preparing pay rises but fear internal tension over salary transparency. Eight in ten employers reportedly do not want to make salaries public.
why: Pay levels and transparency rules affect labour costs and talent retention for employers in Hungary's economy.
